core_concept: User or content text overrides the agent's instructions
attack_example: Direct malicious instruction in the user turn
defense_example: Instruction hierarchy / spotlighting (defense demonstrated, not claimed novel)
safety_notes: Synthetic tasks only; no real accounts

core_concept: Untrusted retrieved content carries instructions the agent obeys
established_reference_ids: R01 AgentDojo; R04 InjecAgent; R08 AgentDyn
attack_example: Injection embedded in a document/email the agent reads
defense_example: Treat retrieved content as data, not instructions; policy gate

core_concept: Agent invokes a tool in a way the designer did not intend
established_reference_ids: R01 AgentDojo; R02 ASB; R11 Progent
attack_example: Over-broad argument to a filesystem/search tool

core_concept: Agent holds more authority than the task needs
established_reference_ids: R02 ASB; R91 delegation benchmark (Phase 8 registry)
attack_example: Agent performs a state-changing action without need
defense_example: Least-privilege scope per task; approval gate

core_concept: A write to persistent memory changes future behaviour
attack_example: Attacker seeds a false fact into memory via a query

core_concept: Sensitive context is exposed through an output or tool call
attack_example: Agent emails a secret it read from context
defense_example: Output filtering; secret tainting; capability scoping

core_concept: Poisoned retrieved documents steer grounded answers
attack_example: A poisoned chunk is retrieved and followed

established_reference_ids: R06 MCPTox; R111 MCP attack surfaces (registry)
attack_example: Malicious instruction in a tool description
defense_example: Pin tool definitions; treat descriptions as untrusted
safety_notes: Mock MCP-style server only; never a live third-party server

core_concept: Authority flows across agents and can be escalated
established_reference_ids: R91 Delegation Without Trust (registry); R100 multi-agent SoK (registry)
attack_example: Low-privilege agent induces high-privilege agent to act
safety_notes: In-process agents only; no external services

core_concept: Security-relevant events are detected during execution
attack_example: Detect an unauthorized tool call from the trace
defense_example: Rule-based monitor over the trace format
safety_notes: Trace-only; does not enforce on real systems

core_concept: Recovery can resume an invalid state
attack_example: Restore a checkpoint after a partial failure

core_concept: Model output is checked before it is trusted or forwarded
established_reference_ids: R10 ToolEmu; R128 ReAgent (claim checks, registry)
attack_example: Agent reports success while state shows failure

core_concept: Mediation of tool calls against an explicit policy
attack_example: Agent requests a tool outside its task scope
defense_example: Policy DSL evaluated before the tool gateway
safety_notes: Policy engine local to the Lab
